title: Bikelanes Tags
description: Schema for the `tags` JSONB column of the `bikelanes` database table. Each object represents one piece of cycling infrastructure derived from OpenStreetMap data.

category.description: Infrastructure category. Central classification used for styling and analysis.

prefix.description: The OSM tag prefix used to derive this feature (e.g. `cycleway` from `cycleway:right:*`). Null for standalone ways.

_parent_highway.description: Highway type of the parent road for projected (left/right) geometries. Null for standalone ways.

_is_sidepath.description: Whether this way is identified (via external CSV data) as a sidepath running alongside a road.

name.description: Name of the associated road (from `name=*`, `ref=*`, `is_sidepath:of:name=*`, or `street:name=*`).

length.description: Length of the way in metres (projected in EPSG:5243, rounded to 2 decimal places).

offset.description: Lateral offset from the road centre line in metres. Negative = left side, positive = right side. Only set for projected (left/right) geometries.

_implicitOneWayConfidence.description: Confidence in the derived oneway value. Used to trigger the `missing_oneway` todo.

lifecycle.description: Lifecycle status. `temporary` indicates a temporary installation. Other values reflect OSM lifecycle prefix conventions.

width_effective.description: Effective/usable width in metres (`width:effective=*`). May be less than `width` due to obstacles.

surface.description: Pavement type. Sanitised and normalised from OSM `surface=*`.

surface_source.description: How the surface value was obtained.

surface_color.description: Colour marking on the cycle path surface.

smoothness.description: Ride quality. Derived from `smoothness=*` or inferred from `surface=*`. Normalised to a simplified scale.

smoothness_source.description: How the smoothness value was obtained.

separation_left.description: Physical separation on the left side of this cycle track (in direction of travel). From `separation:left=*` / `separation:both=*` / `separation=*`.

separation_right.description: Physical separation on the right side of this cycle track. From `separation:right=*` / `separation:both=*`.

buffer_left.description: Buffer/clearance on the left side in metres (`buffer:left=*`).

buffer_right.description: Buffer/clearance on the right side in metres (`buffer:right=*`).

marking_left.description: Road marking type on the left edge of this lane (`marking:left=*`).

marking_right.description: Road marking type on the right edge of this lane (`marking:right=*`).

traffic_mode_left.description: Type of traffic using the space immediately to the left of this lane. May be inferred from `parking:left=*` for protected lane categories.

traffic_mode_right.description: Type of traffic using the space immediately to the right of this lane. May be inferred from `parking:right=*` for protected lane categories.

traffic_sign.description: Primary traffic sign(s) applicable in both directions (from `traffic_sign=*` or `traffic_sign:both=*`). Sanitised.

traffic_sign:forward.description: Traffic sign(s) in the forward direction (`traffic_sign:forward=*`). Sanitised.

traffic_sign:backward.description: Traffic sign(s) in the backward direction (`traffic_sign:backward=*`). Sanitised.

mapillary.description: Mapillary sequence key(s). Multiple values are semicolon-separated. Merged from `mapillary=*` and `source:mapillary=*`.

mapillary_forward.description: Mapillary sequence key(s) for the forward direction.

mapillary_backward.description: Mapillary sequence key(s) for the backward direction.

mapillary_traffic_sign.description: Mapillary sequence key(s) documenting the traffic sign.

mapillary_coverage.description: Whether this section is covered by a Mapillary street-level sequence (from external CSV pseudo-tag data). Used to prioritise todos.

bridge.description: The way is on a bridge.

tunnel.description: The way goes through a tunnel.

description.description: Free-text description or note. From `description=*` or `note=*`. May contain TILDA-specific hints (prefix `TILDA-Hinweis:`). Multiple values are semicolon-separated.

covered.description: The way is covered or indoors.

todos.description: Human-readable Markdown list of data quality issues for display in the inspector.

categoryValues.description: All possible values for the `category` property.

separationValues.description: Allowed values for separation_left and separation_right.

markingValues.description: Allowed values for marking_left and marking_right.

trafficModeValues.description: Allowed values for traffic_mode_left and traffic_mode_right.

todoIds.description: All possible todo IDs that can appear in the todos_lines table.
